context: M18 o1. Nick's dark office, second brownout. Eleni, Yiannis and a lantern. Nick explains.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Power's out until three. The compressors stop. We had a failure. Terrible failure.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Half the pledged coats go out the dock. The claim says they spoiled.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: And the lieutenant's men watch the street. For a cut.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everybody gets paid, Yiannis. That's payroll.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: No. That's theft with a payroll. I'll load the truck. Don't ask me to count.
